verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered-agent docs describe handling of 'official mail': alerts on arrival, scanning and upload to cloud storage, email notice with reminders, and a postcard. They also mention junk-mail filtering, so incoming mail is at least triaged by category. However, nothing explicitly separates service of process from ordinary mail or states distinct delivery times or SLAs for legal papers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of service-of-process handling as a separate workflow, distinct delivery commitments/timeframes for served papers versus ordinary mail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
